I write for general readers about asylum and immigration policy in the UK, Europe and Latin America, and about local democracy in London.

## Media enquiries

I comment on UK asylum and small-boats policy, refugee and migration policy in Latin America, Venezuelan displacement, and the representativeness of local government. I give interviews in English, Spanish and Italian. Email omar.hammoud-gallego@durham.ac.uk.
